hints.title: Two-Dimensional Prefix Range Aggregation
hints.text: Dynamic cell updates combined with rectangle sum queries necessitate an index structure capable of logarithmic point updates and prefix sums across two dimensions.

hints.title: Binary Indexed Tree Over Matrix Coordinates
hints.text: Maintain a 2D tree using lowbit isolation across both row and column axes. Point updates propagate deltas through ancestors; region queries combine four corner prefix evaluations.

hints.title: Coordinate Arithmetic Blueprint
hints.text: In update(r, c, val), compute delta = val - current[r][c]. Add delta along 2D bit lines by incrementing indices by index & -index. In sumRegion, apply inclusion-exclusion: query(r2, c2) - query(r1-1, c2) - query(r2, c1-1) + query(r1-1, c1-1).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Both point updates and rectangle queries execute in logarithmic time in both dimensions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing 2D prefix tables on every point update takes O(M * N) per write, causing timeouts on large operation sequences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual-axis Binary Indexed Tree delivers balanced O(log M * log N) reads and writes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correct 1-based bit manipulation and 2D inclusion-exclusion corner subtraction.
